Subject: Embeddings + Rerank: Staged Hydration Waves & Validation Matrix

Hi Lily / Acme team —

Great to start this thread. Per our kickoff call last week, I want to lock in a pragmatic, low-risk migration approach for seeding your vector index and validating the reranker before we flip traffic. The goal: predictable latency and predictable unit cost while we scale.

High-level proposal (please review / comment):

- Staged hydration waves: seed ~10% of high-value docs first (Wave 0), then 30%, then 60%+ full hydration. Waves driven by priority keys (see attachment).
- Rerank validation matrix: for each wave we run a smoke matrix with: precision@5, latency p95, regeneration-rate, and human-blind A/B across 200 queries (attachment: rerank-smoke-matrix.xlsx).
- Vector DB plan: run FAISS-based local seed with fallback to managed Milvus cluster for full scale. Keep a hot prefix cache in Redwood for top queries.
- Backfill pattern: incremental hydration jobs (30m windows) with rate limits and KV cache warmup.
- Acceptance: "Wave green" = precision uplift >= 6% vs baseline AND p95 latency < 150ms on dedicated test route.

Attachments: acme_priority_keys.csv (priority id list), rerank-smoke-matrix.xlsx, migration-ops-checklist.md

Please confirm that the priority key list maps to the fields you expect and share any compliance requirements (e.g., do we need to limit TTLs or avoid syncing certain PII fields into the vector store).

Next step: if you're good with the plan, Marissa will propose exact dates for Wave 0 hydration and a 2-week validation window.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rohan — looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Priority keys: the CSV aligns to our product taxonomy. We'll add two more "sensitive" buckets (rows flagged) we don't want synced to managed vectorstore; we can include a redacted vector for those if needed.
- Dataset size: ~12M documents total; Wave 0 (10%) = ~1.2M; we can provide a sanitized export for the first wave by Jul 21.
- Compliance: we require a 30-day audit log for ingestion; can Redwood expose a per-batch audit record?

We can commit to the Wave 0 export on Jul 21. For the rerank A/B we prefer a blind human eval via our in-house reviewers; we'll coordinate sample IDs after we get the rerank-smoke-matrix.

Lily

Great details, Lily — thanks for the dataset sizing and compliance ask. Quick notes from ops / schedule perspective: 

- Audit logs: yes, Redwood can produce per-batch ingestion manifests and an append-only audit stream for 30+ days (we'll include an export hook to your S3). I'll add this to the ops checklist.
- Timeline: propose Wave 0 hydration job on Jul 23 (ingest window Jul 23-24), validation window Jul 24-30 (exploratory smoke + blind eval). If Jul 21 is the export date, that gives us two days to validate the sanitized package.
- Resource plan: Wave 0 will run on dedicated nodes (we recommend 2x A10g equiv for the backfill to stay under the rate limit). If costs look high we can throttle ingestion and keep the jobs longer.
- Rerank eval: Monica will own the human-blind sample setup and results capture. Karthik will own the vector DB config and quantization tradeoffs (int8 vs fp16) for production.

Action items (internal + external):
- Acme: confirm Jul 21 export and mark sensitive rows in CSV (Lily)
- Redwood (Marissa): schedule ingestion run Jul 23; provision nodes; send preflight checklist by Jul 20
- Redwood (Monica): produce blind eval template and share with Acme by Jul 22
- Redwood (Karthik): propose FAISS seed + Milvus full plan and recommended quant settings by Jul 20

I'll attach a simple ops checklist (migration-ops-checklist.md) to this thread; please flag any missing items.

-Marissa

Thanks team — summary and next steps: 

- Compliance: no raw text will leave Acme VPC for sensitive buckets; Redwood will accept redacted vectors for flagged rows. Audit exports will be pushed to Acme S3 and not retained beyond 30 days unless requested.
- Dates locked: Jul 21 (sanitized export), Jul 23-24 (Wave 0 hydration), Jul 24-30 (validation + blind eval).
- Owners: Marissa (ingest ops), Monica (blind eval), Karthik (vector DB + quant settings), Rohan (overall PM).
- Acceptance gate: Precision uplift >= 6% AND p95 < 150ms on test route. If either fails we run a remedial pass using tighter vector quant or smaller batch sizes and revalidate for a second window (up to 7 days).

I'll circulate the preflight checklist on Mon Jul 21 once we have the sanitized export.

Rohan
